entries.author: MandelDuck
entries.text:
David Attenborough: Bitcoiners in the wild

In this film, we follow one of the most fascinating and least understood species on planet Earth… the Bitcoiner [video]
entries.suggested_post: The Bitcoiner is the only species that hibernates through the bear market and still checks the price every hour.
entries.image_alt: Rare species: the Bitcoiner, seen through binoculars
entries.suggested_alt:
Scientists finally observed a Bitcoiner in the wild.

It approached slowly, made eye contact, and asked if they'd heard of self-custody.

entries.author: MandelDuck
entries.text:
Bitcoin Seinfeld: Bitcoiners at the Airport part 3

This one actually happened to me, and a few others have said similar stories, have you noticed it? [video]
entries.suggested_post:
Airport security asked if I had anything to declare.

I said 21 million is a hard cap.

I'm writing this from a small room.
entries.suggested_alt:
Spotting another Bitcoiner at the airport is like meeting someone from your hometown.

Except your hometown is a group chat that won't stop yelling.

entries.author: MandelDuck
entries.text:
Bitcoin Seinfeld: Bitcoiners at the airport part 4
Anybody else got those post conference blues? (or conference fatigue?) [video]
entries.suggested_post: Post-conference blues is going from a room where everyone agrees with you to a dinner table where you're the cautionary tale.
entries.suggested_alt: Worst part of a Bitcoin conference is flying home and remembering normal people think "self-custody" is a parenting term.

entries.author: pete_rizzo_
entries.text:
13 YEARS OF "EXPERTS" SAYING #BITCOIN IS GOING TO $0

THEY NEVER LEARN 🤣 [video]
entries.suggested_post:
Experts have called Bitcoin going to zero for 13 years.

At this point it's not a prediction. It's a holiday tradition.
entries.suggested_alt:
Bitcoin has died so many times it should be a horror franchise.

Every sequel, same ending. The experts never survive.

entries.author: Prinz_Land
entries.text:
Advice to #Bitcoin Leverage Traders:

Trade only $BTC and do your analysis very well before entering a trade. Set your SL at -20% to -30%.

When you hit SL, try again. When you hit another SL, try again. When you blow your account, deposit again. …
entries.suggested_post:
My leverage strategy has three steps:

Open position. Hit stop loss. Deposit again.

My exchange calls me a loyal customer.
entries.suggested_alt:
Leverage traders don't have a strategy.

They have a subscription. Monthly deposit. Cancel anytime. Never do.
